review_candidates.title: Human Resource Manager
review_candidates.description: Company Description The Hands On Children’s Museum is located on the picturesque East Bay waterfront in downtown Olympia. We are a nationally known family learning destination and the most visited children’s museum in the Pacific Northwest hosting more than 300,000 visitors each year. Our mission is to stimulate curiosity, creativity, and critical thinking skills through rich, interactive learning experiences. We believe that all children deserve respect and the opportunity to learn, regardless of their ability to pay, which is why the Museum works hard to serve more than one-third of its annual visitation through the Inspired Learning for All initiative. The Museum is recognized as a national Museum for All and won a Noyce Foundation Bright Lights Award for bringing art and science education to underserved populations. Voted a “Best Place for Kids” for more than a decade, the Museum offers a state-of-the-art LEED Gold facility with 150 indoor exhibits, a half-acre Outdoor Discovery Center, Art Studio, a MakeSpace for tinkering and inventing, café and gift shop, and award-winning education programs including camps, workshops, preschool, parenting classes, field trips, community outreach and family support programs. Role Description The Human Resource Manager is a full-time, on-site role based in Olympia, WA. Do you love people, problem-solving, and purpose driven work? Are you the kind of person who can juggle recruiting, employee support, compliance, and still bring positive energy to the table? If so, we have the position for you! At the Hands On Children’s Museum, we believe work should be meaningful and even a little fun. As our Human Resources Manager , you’ll be the heartbeat of our employee experience, helping create a workplace where people feel supported, engaged, and inspired. From welcoming new hires to guiding managers, managing benefits, and keeping us compliant, you’ll touch every part of the employee journey. Think of it as part HR pro, part culture champion, part problem-solver superhero. What You Will Be Doing: People & Culture Be the go-to for employee questions on policies, benefits, and payroll Support managers with employee relations, coaching, and conflict resolution Help build a workplace culture that’s positive, inclusive, and engaging Talent & Onboarding Recruit and hire employees (post jobs, screen candidates, coordinate interviews) Lead onboarding and orientations that make new hires feel welcome from day one Support smooth offboarding experiences HR Operations & Compliance Process semi-monthly payroll Maintain HRIS systems and accurate employee records Ensure compliance with HR laws and regulations (local, state & federal) Manage employee leave programs (FMLA, WA PFML, etc.) Benefits & Programs Oversee benefits enrollment and vendor coordination Manage Open Enrollment for employee benefits Support employee recognition programs and staff communications Training & Development Track required training and coordinate sessions Help ensure employees have the tools they need to succeed Bonus Fun Stuff Help plan all-staff meetings Be part of (and help lead!) the FUN Committee Foster engagement across the museum team Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Bachelor’s degree in HR, Business, or related field (or HR certification -- SHRM-CP/PHR) 3+ years of HR experience (nonprofit experience is a plus!) Strong knowledge of employment laws and HR best practices Experience with HRIS systems (Paylocity, ADP, etc.) Great communication skills and a people-first mindset Ability to handle confidential info with professionalism Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented approach Bonus points if you love facilitating positive workplaces and can bring a little energy into everything you do Physical Demands: ·        Must be able to sit for long periods at a time and complete work at a desk Visit https://acrobat.adobe.com/id/urn:aaid:sc:VA6C2:16131d4b-665f-42d0-9b4b-17784e538073 for a detailed description of responsibilities. Workplace Values: Achieving our mission requires great people who actively demonstrate our core values . To apply, please submit a cover letter, resume, and 3 professional references. https://recruiting.paylocity.com/Recruiting/Jobs/Details/4483373/Hands-On-Childrens-Museum/Human-Resource-Manager Compensation & Benefits: $68,640 - $83,200 DOQ, medical, dental, and vision, paid holidays and time off, a 401(k) retirement plan, and lots of adorable children. Benefits vary by number of regularly scheduled hours worked, length of employment, and employment status. review_candidates.title: First line factory Engineer ASML
review_candidates.description: Functieomschrijving Als First Line Factory Engineer bij ASML ben jij het eerste aanspreekpunt bij technische vraagstukken binnen de assemblage van hoogwaardige mechatronische systemen en modules. Je bent veel aanwezig op de productievloer en werkt nauw samen met operators, monteurs, kwaliteitsmedewerkers en engineers. Wanneer er tijdens het assemblageproces technische afwijkingen of verstoringen ontstaan, kom jij in actie. Je onderzoekt waar het probleem zit, analyseert de oorzaak en ondersteunt bij het vinden van een passende oplossing. Daarbij kijk je niet alleen naar het direct oplossen van problemen, maar signaleer je ook terugkerende afwijkingen en draag je bij aan structurele verbeteringen. Je vormt een belangrijke schakel tussen de productieafdeling en Engineering en Quality. Door jouw technische kennis en hands-on mentaliteit zorg je ervoor dat het productieproces zo efficiënt en betrouwbaar mogelijk blijft verlopen. Jouw Taken En Verantwoordelijkheden Oplossen van eerstelijns technische verstoringen op de productievloer. Analyseren en beoordelen van technische afwijkingen aan mechatronische systemen en modules. Ondersteunen van operators en monteurs bij technische vraagstukken en werkinstructies. Registreren en rapporteren van technische afwijkingen volgens de geldende procedures. Samenwerken met de afdelingen Quality en Engineering om structurele oplossingen te realiseren. Signaleren van terugkerende problemen en initiëren van verbeteracties. Meedenken over het verbeteren en optimaliseren van assemblageprocessen. Bijdragen aan een stabiel, veilig en efficiënt productieproces. Functie-eisen Voor deze functie zoeken we een praktische techneut die graag dicht bij het product staat. Je bent analytisch sterk, kunt snel schakelen en vindt het leuk om technische problemen op te lossen. Je voelt je thuis in een dynamische productieomgeving en weet goed samen te werken met verschillende disciplines. Daarnaast Beschik Je Over Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding in een technische richting, zoals Werktuigbouwkunde, Mechatronica of Elektrotechniek. Ervaring binnen een productie-, assemblage- of hightechomgeving. Technisch inzicht en een sterk probleemoplossend vermogen. Een hands-on mentaliteit en een gestructureerde manier van werken. Goede communicatieve vaardigheden en het vermogen om met verschillende disciplines samen te werken. Een nauwkeurige en kwaliteitsgerichte werkhouding. Een goede beheersing van de Engelse taal. Nederlands is een pré. Arbeidsvoorwaarden Je komt terecht in een innovatieve hightechwerkomgeving waar technologie, kwaliteit en samenwerking centraal staan. Daarnaast kun je rekenen op: Een bruto salaris van €3500 tot €4500 o.b.v. een fulltime werkweek. Een uitdagende technische functie binnen ASML. Werken aan hoogwaardige en complexe mechatronische systemen. Veel verantwoordelijkheid en zelfstandigheid op de productievloer. Samenwerken met verschillende technische disciplines. Mogelijkheden om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen binnen een internationale organisatie. Een dynamische werkomgeving waarin continu verbeteren centraal staat. Info over het bedrijf ASML is een internationale hightechorganisatie en wereldmarktleider op het gebied van lithografiesystemen voor de halfgeleiderindustrie. Vanuit Veldhoven ontwikkelt en produceert ASML geavanceerde machines die worden gebruikt bij de productie van computerchips. Binnen ASML werken duizenden specialisten dagelijks samen aan innovatieve technologie. De productieomgeving kenmerkt zich door complexe technische systemen, hoge kwaliteitsstandaarden en een sterke focus op samenwerking en continue verbetering.

The role focuses on operational excellence, team leadership, execution of priority events and exhibitions, and the implementation and continuous improvement of established processes, tools, and ways of working. Managing the day-to-day operation of the Events & Exhibitions CoE, including demand intake, prioritization, portfolio visibility, resource allocation, stakeholder engagement, and execution of the agreed CoE roadmap and service offering. Managing high-quality event delivery by overseeing event planning, suppliers, logistics, production, registration, lead capture, event technology, budgets, reporting, and on-site execution, while ensuring compliance with CoE standards, governance requirements, and ABB policies. Overseeing event performance, operational KPIs, CoE tools, self-service resources, and supplier partnerships, while continuously improving delivery efficiency, adoption of CoE services, and the overall event experience across Motion divisions and regions. Qualifications For The Role 8+ years of experience in Communications, Marketing, Event Management, or a related field, including 5+ years in event management. Leadership experience within a global or matrix organization, with demonstrated team management and development capabilities. Solid experience of managing complex event portfolios, budgets, suppliers, and multi-regional event delivery. Well-developed project management, execution, organizational, and stakeholder management skills. Knowledge of physical, hybrid, and digital event formats, including engagement strategies, lead capture, and event technology platforms. Experience working in multinational, cross-cultural environments; experience in a CoE or shared services model. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, Event Management, or a related field. Self-managed professional with a solution-oriented, practical mindset; experience leveraging KPIs and insights for continuous improvement; willingness to travel; fluent in English. review_candidates.title: Event Director
review_candidates.description: Reports to: CEO / General Manager / Portfolio Director, MMI Asia Pte Ltd Based in: We don’t really care where you connect to wifi. We care about your results. Singapore/Thailand/Vietnam/Philippines/Malaysia, with regular travel across Southeast Asia Leads: A cross-functional show team – sales, marketing, operations, buyer acquisition, and content An entire industry has a place to meet three days a year. You're the reason it's worth their time. But you don't run an event. You run a marketplace where buyers meet sellers. And you own the numbers at the top and bottom of it. The Opportunity As Event Director, you will own one or more of our trade fair brands end to end. You will set the long-term vision, hit (and beat) the commercial targets, keep customers at the centre of everything you do, and lead a multidisciplinary team across sales, marketing, operations and content. You will be the recognised face of your shows in their industries, and the connective tissue between MMI Asia and the wider Messe München global network. This is a role with genuine ownership and the autonomy to make your mark. What You’ll Own Strategy & growth Define the 3–5 year vision and annual strategy for your portfolio, identifying where to grow – new sectors, new geographies and new formats across live, hybrid and digital. Spot and develop new opportunities, from feature zones and co-located conferences to brand extensions, geo-clones and greenfield launches across ASEAN. Use customer insight, market data and competitor intelligence to keep your shows ahead of the curve. Commercial & P&L ownership Own the full P&L for your portfolio – budgeting, forecasting, pricing and growing margin year on year. Set and steer sales targets across exhibition space, sponsorship and partnerships, working hand in hand with your sales team and commercial leaders. Report performance, risks and opportunities clearly and on time to the General Manager and leadership. Customer & market Build and protect strong relationships with key exhibitors, sponsors, associations, partners and senior industry stakeholders. Champion an outstanding experience for exhibitors and visitors – tracking satisfaction and loyalty, and acting on what you learn. Represent your brands at industry events and in the media as a credible, well-connected voice. People & leadership Build, lead, coach and inspire a high-performing, cross-functional show team. Set clear goals, give honest feedback, and create an environment where people grow and do their best work. Delivery & operations Oversee flawless end-to-end delivery of every edition – from concept and planning to onsite execution and post-show review. Partner with operations teams, venues and contractors to ensure safe, high-quality, well-run events. Direct the marketing and product development plans that drive visitor and exhibitor numbers. Network & collaboration Work within a matrix structure, coordinating with teams and departments across the global Messe München network. Share and adopt best practice in data, marketing and commercial infrastructure across the portfolio. What You’ll Bring 10+ years of commercial track record, P&L responsibility and growth obsession – not necessarily in exhibition or B2B events industry 5+ years leading and developing multinational, cross-functional teams. ASEAN launch and growth experience mixed with comfort working across cultures and time zones. An analytical, detail-minded approach and the ability to juggle multiple priorities under tight deadlines. Excellent written and spoken English; additional ASEAN languages are a plus. Willingness to travel across the region and to work flexibly around event peaks. Why Join Us You want to make money (who are we kidding?) – attractive pay and entrepreneurial incentive Real ownership – a portfolio to call your own and the autonomy to shape it. Global backing – the resources, brands and network of Messe München behind you. Real impact – the chance to build market-leading platforms that move entire industries forward. A great team – diverse, international and entrepreneurial, based in the heart of ASEAN. About MMI Asia MMI Asia is the Singapore-based subsidiary of Messe München – one of the world’s largest and most respected exhibition organisers. Yes, we are home to the F.C. Bayern Munich, Oktoberfest (we call it Wiesn), pretzels, and Adele’s spectacular summer concerts. We’re now in an ambitious growth phase in the region, through new launches, geo-clones, partnerships, joint ventures, and acquisitions. We hire ambitious, people-first professionals and give them the brands, the backing, and the room to do the best work of their careers.

review_candidates.description: Company Description Hornibrook NGI Ltd is a premier steel fabrication and building company with a long-standing role in Papua New Guinea’s industrial and resource development. The company focuses on delivering cost-effective products and services that drive customer satisfaction and long-term partnerships. Team members benefit from daily meals,, and a culture that prioritizes health, wellbeing, and continuous improvement. Hornibrook NGI Ltd is committed to quality and excellence on projects of all sizes and continues to build a strong future through capability and expertise. Role Description The Estimator is a full-time, on-site role based in Lae, responsible for preparing accurate cost estimates for steel fabrication and building projects. Day-to-day tasks include reviewing drawings and specifications, quantifying materials and labor, and preparing detailed cost breakdowns and tender submissions. The Estimator collaborates closely with engineering, project management, and procurement teams to clarify scope, identify cost-saving opportunities, and ensure quotes meet technical and commercial requirements. The role also involves updating and maintaining estimating databases, tracking market rates, and supporting negotiations with clients and suppliers. The Estimator contributes to project risk assessments and provides regular input on budgets and variations throughout the project lifecycle. Qualifications Strong numeracy and analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to prepare detailed material, labor, and equipment cost estimates. Experience interpreting engineering drawings, construction plans, and technical specifications for steel fabrication or building projects. Proficiency with estimating software and MS Office applications (especially Excel) for costing, data analysis, and reporting. Knowledge of construction and fabrication methods, local industry standards, and typical project workflows in PNG or similar environments. Effective communication and collaboration skills to work with project managers, engineers, suppliers, and clients. Strong organizational and time management abilities to handle multiple tenders and deadlines with attention to detail. Relevant technical qualification or trade background in construction, engineering, quantity surveying, or a related field. Prior experience in estimating or quantity surveying within steel fabrication, building, or industrial projects is highly beneficial. Commitment to safety, quality, and continuous improvement in line with Hornibrook NGI Ltd’s values.

review_candidates.description: Equipment Supervisor | Senai, Johor | Lead Equipment Reliability for a Global Automotive Manufacturer This is a chance to lead equipment maintenance and reliability at the first overseas manufacturing facility of a global automotive components manufacturer. About The Client Mills Recruitment is partnering with a leading global automotive components manufacturer to hire an Equipment Supervisor based at its manufacturing facility in Senai, Johor, Malaysia, supporting the reliability and performance of its automated production equipment. The role Develop and improve preventive and predictive maintenance programs for production equipment, including wiper motor assembly lines, coating lines and industrial robots. Lead equipment installation, commissioning, testing and acceptance for new projects, line modifications and equipment upgrades. Troubleshoot electrical, PLC, pneumatic, hydraulic and mechanical failures, and apply root cause analysis (8D, 5 Why) to prevent recurring issues. Implement TPM and autonomous maintenance, and improve OEE, MTBF and MTTR performance. Manage spare parts inventory, procurement planning and maintenance costs, and report on downtime, costs and OEE. Maintain maintenance schedules, equipment records and documentation in line with IATF 16949, and ensure compliance with LOTO, machine guarding and other safety standards. Supervise, train and develop maintenance technicians, and work with Production, Quality, Process Engineering, EHS and equipment suppliers on equipment issues, capacity planning and line layout improvements. About you Must-haves Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a related discipline. At least 5 years of equipment maintenance or plant engineering experience in the automotive industry (Tier 1 or OEM), including at least 3 years managing non-standard or customised equipment. Strong hands-on knowledge of PLC systems such as Siemens, Allen-Bradley or Mitsubishi. Experience troubleshooting servo drives, industrial robots, automated assembly equipment and electrical control systems. Solid understanding of pneumatic and hydraulic systems, sensors, electrical circuits and mechanical transmission systems. Proven experience implementing TPM, preventive maintenance systems and CMMS. Strong understanding of IATF 16949, including equipment maintenance records, calibration requirements and equipment-related FMEA. Ability to read electrical schematics, mechanical drawings and equipment technical documentation, with proficiency in AutoCAD and Excel. Experience leading maintenance technicians and coordinating cross-functional engineering teams. Good communication skills with fluency in English and Mandarin to effectively communicate with our diverse client and stakeholders. Willingness to work on the shop floor and travel occasionally for supplier or customer visits. Nice-to-haves: Experience maintaining automotive motor assembly lines or wiper motor production equipment (highly preferred). Familiarity with 3D modelling software. Experience using Minitab for data analysis. What's on offer Employment type: Permanent Hours: Mondays to Fridays; 9:00AM - 6:00PM Location: Senai, Johor. Growth: A leadership role building maintenance systems and a technician team at a newly established facility within a global group. review_candidates.title: Développeur(euse) Principal(e) en Systèmes Embarqués
review_candidates.description: MANNARINO Systems & Software Inc. est un leader dans la fourniture de systèmes critiques, de logiciels, de matériel et de services d'ingénierie de certification aux industries de l'aérospatiale, de la défense, de l'espace, de la simulation et de la production d'énergie. Notre clientèle est très large, couvrant les entreprises aérospatiales traditionnelles ainsi que des marchés nouveaux et passionnants, y compris la propulsion électrique, la mobilité aérienne urbaine, les véhicules aériens sans pilote et le vol autonome. La culture de MANNARINO est axée sur la qualité, le travail, le professionnalisme et le travail d'équipe dans une atmosphère très respectueuse et motivante, axée sur la croissance à long terme de l'entreprise. En tant que membre de notre équipe, vous en bénéficierez : D’une gamme complète d’assurance collective et un plan RÉER collectif; D’une politique d’horaire flexible; D’une prime discrétionnaire ; Du remboursement des frais de conditionnement physique; D'autres avantages, tels que des dîners hebdomadaires par un traiteur de même que des boissons chaudes à volonté (expresso, café, chocolat chaud, thé); Des sorties régulières avec les membres de l’équipe. Rôle/Responsabilités du Poste Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) Développeur(euse) principal(e) en systèmes embarqués possédant 10 ans ou plus d’expérience pour contribuer à des projets avancés de recherche et développement (R-D) dans le domaine de la Défense, mettant en œuvre des systèmes embarqués, des activités de cybersécurité et des technologies numériques complexes. Ce rôle combine le développement logiciel embarqué, l’interaction matériel-logiciel, les tests de cybersécurité et l’analyse de systèmes dans des environnements critiques. En collaboration avec des développeurs logiciels, des spécialistes en sécurité matérielle et des experts en intelligence artificielle, vous participerez à la conception, au développement, aux essais et au déploiement de logiciels pour des plateformes embarquées. Vous contribuerez également à l’analyse du comportement des systèmes, à l’identification de vulnérabilités potentielles et au développement de solutions robustes destinées à protéger des technologies opérationnelles critiques. Ces projets soutiennent des applications de défense et exigent une compréhension approfondie des architectures complexes, des contraintes matérielles et des environnements opérationnels réels. Ce poste s’adresse à un(e) professionnel(le) expérimenté(e) possédant de solides compétences en développement embarqué ainsi qu’une expérience pratique en intégration de systèmes, en cybersécurité et en interaction matériel-logiciel. Responsabilités du Poste Diriger et contribuer à la conception, au développement, aux essais et au déploiement de logiciels pour systèmes embarqués. Réaliser des activités d’ingénierie inverse sur des logiciels et matériels embarqués afin de comprendre leur fonctionnement, analyser leur comportement et identifier les vulnérabilités potentielles. Effectuer des tests d’intrusion et participer aux enquêtes de cybersécurité sur des plateformes embarquées afin d’évaluer les vulnérabilités et de contribuer à leur mitigation. Concevoir, assembler et maintenir des bancs d’essai et des environnements de test destinés à la validation des systèmes et à l’analyse des vulnérabilités. Développer des outils et applications permettant de communiquer avec des systèmes embarqués, d’automatiser des essais et d’analyser le comportement des équipements. Réaliser des essais d’observation, fonctionnels ou destructifs afin de valider les performances des systèmes et de confirmer les vulnérabilités identifiées. Collaborer avec les spécialistes en sécurité matérielle afin d’évaluer et d’améliorer la résilience des plateformes embarquées et des technologies de l’Internet industriel des objets (IIoT). Documenter les résultats techniques, produire des rapports d’essais et communiquer efficacement les constats aux équipes multidisciplinaires et aux parties prenantes. Participer aux activités Agile, notamment la planification des sprints, les réunions quotidiennes, les revues de sprint et les rétrospectives. Encadrer des développeurs moins expérimentés et contribuer à l’amélioration continue des pratiques de développement et des standards de qualité. Compétences Requises 10 ans ou plus d’expérience en développement de logiciels embarqués, en ingénierie des systèmes embarqués ou dans un domaine connexe. Solide expérience de programmation en C, C++ et C#, ainsi qu’avec les langages de script Python, Bash et PowerShell. Expérience approfondie avec des environnements et outils de développement embarqué tels que Keil, STM32CubeIDE ou des plateformes équivalentes. review_candidates.description: Company Description Fred Hour Pvt. Ltd. is a creative technology company that delivers digital solutions, design, and media experiences for a wide range of clients. The team blends strategy, design, and technology to build scalable products that support business growth and innovation. Fred Hour focuses on creating impactful digital experiences that are both user-centered and technically robust. The company values collaboration, creativity, and problem-solving, offering professionals an environment to apply their skills to diverse and evolving projects. JOB DESCRIPTION Work arrangement: Primarily work from home Reports to: Registered Migration Agent About the role This role suits an organised, detail-oriented person who can manage documents accurately and communicate professionally with clients. The Documents and Visa Assistant provides administrative support to a Registered Migration Agent by collecting and checking documents, preparing draft application materials from supplied information and approved templates, and organising complete files for the agent’s review and lodgement. Key responsibilities • Email clients using agent-approved checklists to request required documents and information, explain administrative next steps, and follow up on outstanding items. • Review documents for administrative completeness, legibility and consistency, including names, dates and missing pages; flag discrepancies or concerns to the migration agent. • Prepare and format draft correspondence, document lists and application materials in Microsoft Word using approved templates and the agent’s instructions. • Enter client-supplied information accurately into draft forms and internal records, referring unclear answers tothe agent rather than making assumptions. • Organise, label, scan, merge and save documents in the correct electronic client folders, maintaining clear filenames and version control. • Maintain document checklists, correspondence records and task trackers so outstanding requirements and deadlines remain visible. • Assemble orderly application packs with draft forms, supporting documents and a clear list of any unresolved issues for the agent’s final review and lodgement. • Action the agent’s requested corrections promptly and provide regular updates on file readiness and outstanding client responses. • Handle personal information confidentially and follow the business’s secure remote-working and document-management procedures.Essential skills and attributes • Excellent attention to detail, with strong proofreading and accurate data-entry skills. • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Word, including formatting, tables, templates and Track Changes. • Strong written English and a professional, clear and courteous email manner. • Good organisational skills and the ability to prioritise tasks, follow checklists and meet agreed deadlines. • Confidence managing electronic documents, email attachments and PDF files. • Ability to work independently from home, follow instructions carefully and ask questions when information is unclear. • A reliable internet connection, a suitable computer and a private workspace appropriate for confidential client information. Desirable experience Previous experience in administration, document control, migration support, legal administration or another detail- focused client service role. Familiarity with client-management software and visa documentation workflows would be an advantage. Scope of the role This is an administrative support position, not a migration adviser role. The assistant must refer visa eligibility, migration strategy and legal questions to the Registered Migration Agent. The agent remains responsible for substantive application drafting, immigration advice, final review and lodgement. How to apply Applicants should submit a current resume and a short cover letter outlining their relevant experience, Microsoft Word skills, availability and ability to work effectively from home. Employer note: The administrative scope above reflects OMARA guidance distinguishing clerical support from regulated immigration assistance. See OMARA: Practice management duties

review_candidates.description: The Role We are looking for a senior, hands-on leader to own the commercial success, client experience, and service delivery of a diverse portfolio of clients. The role brings together customer success, commercial ownership, and operations . You’ll work closely with multiple clients at the same time, understand what drives their business, identify risks and growth opportunities, and turn those insights into changes in how we onboard, deliver, organise teams, and use technology. Our service model is evolving across people-led, technology-enabled, and AI-supported services. You’ll need to thrive in this ambiguity, running current operations while building better, scalable systems. What You’ll Own Client Portfolio & Commercial Performance : Own a broad portfolio of clients with different needs and economics. Drive retention, account growth, customer value, and margin, while deciding where intervention is most needed. Client Relationships & Growth : Build strong relationships with clients, understand how their businesses are changing, identify risks and expansion opportunities early, and confidently navigate commercial conversations and trade-offs. Operational Excellence & Scale : Own strong day-to-day service delivery across workforce planning, SLA performance, service quality, escalations, operating cadence, and delivery consistency, while improving how the operation scales. Client Onboarding & Growth Readiness : Collaborate across Growth, Delivery, and HR to make client onboarding repeatable and align workforce planning with demand. Org Design & Capability : Build, select, and develop high-performing teams, design team structures around portfolio needs, and raise the capability of experienced delivery leaders. Cross-Functional Execution : Work closely with Leadership, Product, Tech, and HR to clear dependencies and convert decisions into fast action. What We’re Looking For Client & Commercial Depth : Proven experience managing multiple clients or accounts with different needs and economics. You understand retention, account growth, customer value, cost-to-serve, and margin, and can make sensible trade-offs between them. Strong Client Judgement : Able to understand a client’s business beyond operational metrics, identify what is changing, and decide what needs to happen to protect or grow the relationship. Service Delivery Depth : Strong experience in BPO, managed services, recurring service delivery, or a closely related environment, with hands-on understanding of workforce planning, SLA performance, service quality, escalations, and operational consistency. Critical Thinking & Systems Focus : Ability to analyse complex information, spot underlying patterns, and fix root causes rather than symptoms. Tech Fluency : Comfortable leveraging modern tools, automation, and AI to improve and scale operations. Leadership & Influence : Proven track record of managing managers or senior contributors, challenging experienced leaders constructively, and raising the quality of decision-making across the organisation. People Judgement & Organisation Design : Ability to assess capability, select and develop people, delegate meaningful ownership, and design teams. End-to-End Ownership : You’ve had to understand a customer or business problem, identify what is really causing it, decide what to do, implement the change, and live with the consequences. This Role May Suit You if You... Enjoy managing several clients at the same time and deciding where your attention will have the biggest impact. Like getting to the bottom of messy client and business problems rather than only managing operational metrics. Can move comfortably between client conversations, commercial decisions, and operational detail. Can use findings from one account’s economics and customer experience to improve the broader portfolio and operating model. Can spot when a client relationship is at risk and act before the issue becomes an escalation or churn. Are comfortable having difficult commercial conversations and balancing customer value with cost and margin. Take action, test ideas, and adapt as you learn. Enjoy developing senior leaders and driving results through people while remaining close enough to the work to understand what is really happening. Why Influx? Influx provides 24/7 customer support for leading brands and technology companies worldwide. We’re a fully remote, global company with more than 1,000 people working across 15+ countries. You'll have: Global exposure , working across an international client portfolio and distributed teams. Fully remote work from Indonesia. Broad scope and ownership , spanning clients, operations, commercial performance, people, and technology. Direct access to senior leaders and the opportunity to influence decisions across departments. Room to shape how we operate , as our service models continue to evolve across people, technology, and AI. If you enjoy owning complex client and operational problems, growing strong customer relationships, and turning what you learn into practical change, we’d like to hear from you.

review_candidates.description: Company Description: American University of Phnom Penh (AUPP) is a private, English-language higher education institution located in Cambodia, offering high-quality, American-style academic programs. The university integrates global standards with the cultures of Cambodia and Asia, creating a learning environment that is locally relevant and internationally oriented. AUPP is committed to fostering socially responsible behavior, life-long learning, and both academic and professional excellence. The institution prepares critical thinkers, innovators, and ethical leaders who are equipped to make meaningful contributions in Cambodia, the region, and the wider world. Description: Leads AUPP's Office of Institutional Effectiveness, integrating quality assurance, institutional research, educational compliance, and accreditation. Works with academic and administrative leaders to assess performance, support improvement, and provide reliable evidence for institutional decisions. Personally leads assessment and accreditation work within the university's established governance and approval processes. Essential Functions and Responsibilities: Manage the office's staff, resources, annual work plan, and reporting calendar in consultation with the President. Coordinate academic and administrative assessment and program review with the Vice President of Academic Affairs, deans, and department heads; track evidence of resulting improvements. Lead national and U.S. accreditation preparation, including readiness reviews, self-evaluation, evidence, reports, and visits. Serve as accreditation liaison when designated by the President. Oversee compliance with the Ministry of Education, Youth and Sport (MoEYS) and Accreditation Committee of Cambodia (ACC); review outstanding requirements and corrective actions with the Compliance Officer. Support strategic plan reviews and monitor institutional goals, working with units to connect annual plans and assessment results to university priorities. Direct institutional research priorities and oversee the quality, consistency, confidentiality, and usefulness of institutional data and reports. Guide faculty and staff on assessment and accreditation requirements. Distinguish external requirements from recommendations and route proposed policies through established approval processes. Report findings, material gaps, and recommended actions to the President, and prepare reports for senior management and the Board as requested. Request evidence and coordinate approved reviews. Refer policy, curriculum, staffing, budget, and operational decisions to authorized leaders and governance bodies; escalate unresolved concerns to the President. Required Qualifications Master's degree in higher education, education, assessment, research, public administration, or a related field. At least five years of relevant higher education experience, including leadership of assessment, quality assurance, accreditation, or institutional improvement projects. Practical experience in outcomes assessment and program review, with the ability to interpret and apply accreditation requirements. Strong analytical, project management, and English writing skills, including preparation of clear institutional reports. Ability to lead a small team, work constructively across departments, exercise sound judgment, and handle confidential information. Desired Qualifications Experience with U.S. regional accreditation. Experience in strategic planning or institutional research and familiarity with Cambodian or international higher education.
